T: Same cabin, same book, better snacks.
D: Ash takes his girlfriend to a remote cabin, where an old recording wakes the evil in the woods and keeps him trapped there until dawn.
P: Serve the hand pies when Ash and Linda pull up to the cabin in the opening.
S: they won't stay on the plate if you look away

Boil the diced potato until just tender and drain well. Soften the leek in the butter. Mix the potato, leek, cheddar, thyme, salt and pepper and leave to cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 8 rounds of 12cm from the pastry, spoon in the filling, fold into half moons, crimp the edges and brush with egg. Bake on a lined tray until deep golden.
Jake and Bobby Joe's hush puppies
backwoods fare from the two locals who should have stayed home

Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Whisk the egg and buttermilk, stir into the dry mix with the spring onion and rest. Beat the butter with the honey. Heat the oil in a deep pot to 180C. Drop in heaped tablespoons of batter in batches and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot with the honey butter.
M: brought up from the cellar, whatever else is down there

Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush lightly with a fork and half the butter. Season the chops with the salt and pepper and sear in the oil for 4 minutes a side until just cooked. Rest on a plate. Fry the apples, onion and sage in the rest of the butter until golden. Add 250ml chicken stock and the mustard, bubble to reduce by half, then stir in the cream. Return the chops and their juices to warm through and serve with the potatoes.
Annie Knowby's apple-braised chicken with root vegetables
Annie turns up with the missing pages and a proper dinner

Chicken thighs browned and braised with apple juice, thyme, carrots, parsnips and onion until tender, with crusty bread for the sauce. Brown the chicken skin side down in the oil in a heavy pot, then set aside. Add the onion, carrot and parsnip and colour lightly. Add the apple, apple juice, stock and thyme, put the chicken back on top and simmer covered. Uncover and simmer until the sauce reduces. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23cm pie tin with the pastry and chill. Line with baking paper and rice and blind bake, then lift out the paper and rice. Whisk the eggs, brown sugar, maple syrup, butter, vanilla and salt. Scatter the pecans in the pastry case and pour over the filling. Bake until set with a slight wobble in the centre. Cool completely. Whip the cream to soft peaks and serve with slices of pie.
K: the whole cabin's in on the joke

Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes and remove. Simmer half the peach slices with the sugar and 100ml of the cold water until soft, then strain to a syrup. Stir the syrup, lemon juice and the rest of the cold water into the tea and chill. Pour over ice with the remaining peach slices and a sprig of mint.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Brush the cauliflower steaks with the oil, season with the salt and pepper and roast on a tray, turning once, until tender and browned.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush lightly with a fork and half the butter.
Fry the apples, onion and sage in the rest of the butter until golden.
Add 250ml vegetable stock and the mustard, bubble to reduce by half, then stir in the cream.
Spoon the sauce over the cauliflower steaks and serve with the potatoes.
